newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Plantier bludgeoned to death - Irish coroner.
newsitem.headline: Plantier bludgeoned to death - Irish coroner.

text.p: Ireland's state pathologist said on Thursday that Sophie Toscan du Plantier, wife of a prominent French film producer, was bludgeoned to death with a blunt instrument in an unsolved murder.
He was giving evidence at an inquest into her December 23 slaying at her holiday home in West Cork where her fully clothed body was found by a neighbour.

Pathologist John Harbison told the 15-minute inquest that she had heavy bloodstains on her head and shoulder but said the cause of death was a fractured skull caused by a beating from a blunt instrument.
Harbison said there was no sign of a knife having been used but said there were severe lacerations and swellings to her head caused by a fractured skull.
No member of the du Plantier family was present at the inquest, which was attended by a few French journalists and the French consul, Francois LeTellier.
No one has been charged with the murder but police have sent a file of their investigations to the Department of Public Proesecutions.
